description.value: Highwater House is a custom-built luxury treehouse rental perched in a spruce grove on a private three-acre property within Naikoon Provincial Park on Haida Gwaii, about 10 minutes north of Masset. Situated where the Sangan River meets the Pacific Ocean on South Beach, the fully equipped rental offers sweeping views across endless dunes toward Alaska and Tow Hill. Business management is provided by K'yuu Enterprise Corporation, reflecting the property's connection to the local Haida community.
